heartbleed_authorized_validation.name: CVE-2014-0160 (Heartbleed) Validation
heartbleed_authorized_validation.description: Validate whether authorized TLS services are affected by CVE-2014-0160 and record remediation evidence.

success_criteria.value: Verified vulnerability status using approved internal tooling, documented affected services, and confirmed remediation/retest results.

hints: Only test systems you own or are explicitly authorized to assess
Document service, port, certificate, and software version evidence
After patching, retest and attach proof of non-vulnerable status
